stories.headline: Nvidia board launches independent probe into Jensen Huang after CEO admits affair with alleged Chinese spy
stories.summary: Nvidia's board formed a committee of independent directors and outside counsel to investigate national-security and spying allegations tied to CEO Jensen Huang's disclosed romantic relationship. Shares fell about 4.3% on Monday, erasing roughly $200 billion in market value, though Nvidia says Huang remains CEO 'without interruption.' Republican lawmakers have called for Huang to testify before Congress on November 18.

stories.headline: S&P 500 futures flat, Dow futures up as traders await October CPI report
stories.summary: Dow futures rose about 197 points (0.38%) and S&P 500 futures added 0.16%, while Nasdaq-100 futures were little changed ahead of Tuesday's October CPI release, the last inflation print before the Fed's December meeting. Consensus expects headline CPI at +0.3% month-over-month and core CPI easing to +0.2%, down from September's 0.6% and 0.3% readings. Fed funds futures imply roughly an 84% probability of a 25bp rate cut in December.

stories.headline: China's trade surplus surpasses $1 trillion at record pace
stories.summary: China's cumulative trade surplus has crossed the $1 trillion mark faster than in any prior year, underscoring persistent export strength even as global trade tensions simmer. The milestone highlights the widening imbalance between China's exports and imports, a recurring flashpoint in US-China trade relations.

stories.headline: Boeing to cut 5% of commercial airplane workforce as production ramp-up slips
stories.summary: Boeing is cutting roughly 5% of its commercial airplanes division workforce after delays in ramping up production rates. The move signals continued operational strain in Boeing's commercial jet business even as order backlogs remain large.

stories.headline: Reuters: Anthropic's nearly $70 billion IPO plan briefly circulated to banks, then pulled back
stories.summary: Anthropic reportedly circulated an IPO proposal valuing the AI company at close to $70 billion to banks before retracting it, according to a Reuters exclusive. The episode suggests Anthropic is weighing public-market options but has not committed to a near-term listing.

stories.headline: Honda to invest $3 billion in new Ohio vehicle assembly plant
stories.summary: Honda announced a $3 billion investment in a new vehicle assembly plant in Ohio, part of its push to expand US manufacturing capacity. The investment adds to a wave of automaker reshoring commitments in North America.

stories.headline: PepsiCo cutting around 1,000 jobs across North America
stories.summary: PepsiCo is eliminating roughly 1,000 jobs across its North American operations as part of a broader cost-cutting effort. The cuts come as consumer packaged-goods companies face pressure on margins and softer demand.

stories.headline: Brent crude slumps 7% on Iran peace hopes despite fresh Saudi pipeline attack
stories.summary: Brent crude fell roughly 7% as hopes for an Iran-related peace deal outweighed news of a fresh attack on a Saudi pipeline. The sharp drop in oil prices is easing broader inflation worries ahead of Tuesday's CPI report.

stories.headline: Tesla to end Cybertruck production; Musk says many buyers will get deposits refunded
stories.summary: Tesla is preparing to discontinue the Cybertruck, with CEO Elon Musk saying many reservation holders will have their deposits refunded. The move marks a retreat from one of Tesla's most high-profile recent product launches amid weak sales.
